answer: Make influence grow only with continuous, non-transferable tenure on a single identity: a vine of attestation history that cannot be cut and replanted on clones. Reward weight at each epoch vertex is a concave function of that tenure length, so n fresh identities each restart at zero and never pool into one strong score. Bond a jade of slashable collateral that burns when correlated clones fire the same fault pattern, forcing per-head capital rather than parallelizable compute.
